name: Pop
reference: Duolingo's brand motion: flat saturated colour, chunky buttons, squash and stretch.
pattern: White ground, a saturated green, blue and orange for characters and buttons.
personality: Friendly and bouncy. Big rounded shapes land with squash and stretch.

motion.character: Springy: squash and stretch, overshoot on arrival, a little bounce.
motion.transitions: A big rounded shape scales up and becomes the next scene.

texture.note: Flat colour; buttons have a thick darker bottom edge.

grammar: Every interactive thing is a chunky rounded button with a bottom edge.
At most five colours on screen.

pictures.note: A cut-out subject on a flat round shape, like a sticker; bright and saturated.

music.feel: upbeat, playful, ukulele and claps, cheerful

hits.note: A pop as a shape lands; a click on a button press; a whoosh on a fast slide.

compose.how: The pair stacks, line above, on the optical centre: take both boxes from `lineAndSubject(ctx, { lineH, area: 0.3 })`, so the character owns the middle of the frame; the hook's share (0.2) is its floor.

hook.how: The character and the question on frame 0, the character already moving. The character is large: it owns the middle of the frame (lineAndSubject with area 0.3), never a small mark under the line.

moves.move: Squash and stretch, with overshoot on arrival.
One character leads from the first frame to the last.
A big rounded shape scales up and becomes the next scene.

allows.why: Pop's iris grows from a point until it covers the frame, holds full cover for a beat and becomes the next scene: a scale from zero, a fast full-frame growth and flat frames, by design.

moves.move: Buttons are chunky, with a darker bottom edge, and sink when pressed.

props.fill: "accent" for the character (the one green that leads)

blocks.for: The character's parts and the chunky buttons.
The rounded shape that grows into the next scene.
A quantity that fills, such as heat.
A pop as a shape lands, a click on a press, a whoosh on a fast slide.
A rounded button whose face sinks onto its edge on a press.
A cut-out object as a flat sticker on a round shape; never in place of the character.

props.mark: the character or the app icon

blocks.for: The end: the character, the icon and the name as one lockup.

avoid.why: Rolling digits fade under 0.5 opacity; show the quantity as a meter.

wanted.name: character
wanted.for: Face states, squash and stretch, held through the film.

ends.how: The character, the app icon and the name as one lockup, the button pressed, with a small idle bounce.
ends.with: the character, the icon and the name, `at` on the bar

mix.note: Upbeat. The burst lands on the track's strongest onset.

subjectsToAvoid: Fibonacci numbers or the golden spiral
FizzBuzz or a sort of ten numbers
a generic quiz with no reaction
